tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. A cool, slightly blue paper, like a prescription pad under daylight.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and input fields.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells that hold a photo crop of the handwriting, and empty photo slots.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on paper, surface and tinta-soft. 14.6:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and helper lines, on paper and surface. Kept above 7:1 because readers are older; never lighter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows. Decoration only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and choice tiles. 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: tinta
tokens.usage: Brand blue, the colour of ballpoint ink. Primary buttons, selected choices, links. As text on paper and surface: 7.9:1 or better.

tokens.name: tinta-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of tinta fills.

tokens.name: tinta-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a selected choice tile and of the current step. Text on it is ink or tinta.

tokens.name: on-tinta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tinta fill. White in light, dark ink in dark (the dark tinta is light).

tokens.name: highlighter
tokens.usage: Brand accent, the pharmacist's highlighter. The check in the logo, the one thing on a screen that needs a look, and the dark-theme focus ring. Never text colour.

tokens.name: on-highlighter
tokens.usage: Text on a highlighter fill, in both themes. 11:1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The 'Matches' state: icon and word. Teal, not green, so it never reads as 'safe' and stays clear of red for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a confirmed row or Matches chip. Text on it is ok or ink.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: The 'Check this' state: icon and word, on check-soft and surface.

tokens.name: check-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a row or chip that needs the user to compare with the paper.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: The 'Ask your pharmacist' state: icon and word, on stop-soft and surface. Also destructive buttons.

tokens.name: stop-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a blocked row or chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-control focus: a 3px solid ring, 2px outside the control. 7.9:1 or better on paper and surface.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen, at the top.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Check each line with the paper
styles.usage: Card titles and the name on a dose screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Take a photo of the whole prescription. Make sure all the writing is in the picture.
styles.usage: The one instruction at the top of a step.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Handwriting can be misread. Look at the paper and make sure the name is the same.
styles.usage: Default text. Nothing a user must read is smaller than this, except captions.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Drug names from the US National Library of Medicine, October 2026.
styles.usage: Attribution and fine print only. The floor: never smaller.

styles.name: dose
styles.usage: Strengths, amounts and counts. The mono face keeps 1 and l, 0 and O apart.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: The dose time on alarm and Today screens.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; between rows in a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a screen's main action.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between the step instruction and the content on sparse screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photo crops and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and choice tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the logo tile (24 on a 100 grid).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and the step counter.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest height or width of anything tappable. Larger than the 44pt platform minimum, for unsteady hands.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the main button on a screen.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons beside button and chip words.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of body text on wide screens.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards on paper. Only cards: buttons and chips stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The action bar pinned to the bottom of a step.
